g.text: +KeywordSearch(index : InvertedIndex, docIds : String[], docLengths : int[], averageDocLength : double, documentCount : int, datasetDir : Path)
+Bm25Scorer(index : InvertedIndex, docLengths : int[], averageDocLength : double, documentCount : int)
-largestWeight(terms : String[], weights : double[], first : int) : double
score() fills a dense double[] indexed by doc id
N in the idf is documentCount (indexed documents).
A term given twice counts once, with its largest weight.
The user's stems get weight 1.0; each expansion keyword
is tokenized and stemmed, and stems not already in the
query get 0.5. newTerms(): keywords adding at least one
new stem. words(): the unstemmed query, for snippets.
Bounded binary min-heap of k entries (root = worst kept);
higher score wins, ties go to the lower doc id.
used by POST /api/search. Scores are min-max
